$comment: Pulse config. `brief` is the user's standing identity / voice rules / hard rules / current writing goal — delivered to the agent as a hidden chat-init message at session start (see pulse-app.js sendInitPrompt). `workspace_path` points at the user's product source dir; the agent reads README/doc/source there on every run for product knowledge (read-only, just-in-time via Read/Glob/Grep). `default_goal` is used when a run is triggered without an explicit goal. `sites` toggles source tools + per-site config. `targets` toggles output lanes + per-lane config. Goals dispatch capabilities; capabilities call enabled sites and draft for enabled targets. Reddit is dual-role.
default_goal: Daily X-post if I shipped or learned something yesterday. Skip if nothing meaningful.
